scope: The 30 listed original entrypoints execute complete normal routines. Legacy object and global mutators compare storage, while predicates/getters compare projected out-parameters and existing direct scalar APIs compare their returns. Success status from legacy mutators is not an original EAX comparison. New complete object/piece/player EAX and live address-boundary proofs are reported separately in object-scalar-returns-verification.json; full globals retain their separate verifier. This report makes no full-ABI claim for projected helpers.
